title: Space use is choice-independent
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine and let $N$ be its associated nondeterministic machine, whose two choice transitions both equal the transition of $M$. For every input word, configuration $c$ on that input, and finite choice word $w$, the total number of work-tape cells visited by $N$ under $w$ from $c$ equals the total number visited by $M$ from $c$ through step $|w|$.
hypotheses_covered: Its associated nondeterministic machine uses the deterministic transition for either choice
A finite input word and configuration on that input
A finite word of Boolean choices
